risks.proof: A photo of the BIOS/UEFI screen showing RAM and storage details, or a screenshot of system information (e.g., Windows System Properties or Disk Management).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if having less than 16GB RAM or smaller SSD, which would reduce value significantly.

risks.risk: The laptop may be non-functional or have hidden hardware issues (e.g., battery, screen, ports).
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop powering on, booting into OS, and demonstrating screen, keyboard, touchpad, and ports.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which would reduce value to scrap or parts-only price.

risks.risk: The model may not be G9 (e.g., older G8 or G7 model with sticker or note mislabeled).
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number label on the bottom (photo 0) or a clear shot of the model number from the BIOS or system info.

proof_requests: Photo of the BIOS/UEFI screen or system information showing RAM and storage details.
Video of the laptop powering on and booting into the operating system.
Clear photo of the serial number label on the bottom of the laptop (photo 0).
response.reason: The model and brand are supported by visible evidence, but critical specs (RAM, SSD) are only claimed via a handwritten note and not verifiable from the photos. Functionality and exact model generation are also unproven. Without proof of specs and working condition, the item cannot be priced accurately.
